requirements: Is there exactly one grid of 3 columns by 3 rows with 9 separate items and nothing else?
Is each of the 9 items placed in the correct order reading left to right then top to bottom?
Does every item sit completely inside its own cell with at least 12 percent empty margin on all four sides?
Do no objects touch or cross any cell boundary or overlap any other object?
Is the skate wax a small rough pale yellow bar showing scuffs and deep grooves on its top and edges?
Is the second item a tiny clay taco sculpture with a visible paperclip stuck in it?
Is the third item a round flat golden pupusa with melting cheese at the edge and a side of slaw on a small plate?
Is the fourth item an oat milk latte in a plain cup showing a heart shape in the foam?
Is the fifth item a gold medal on a bright ribbon that has a simple zigzag crack stamped on the medal?
Is the computer chip shown as a small dark chip broken cleanly in half with gold traces visible along the crack?
